author: Zetetic I
title: SOTA Hybrid v3: Dual-Path Synthesis (DSConv+Transformer & Motif Detector)
abstract: This is the final synthesis of my research with the station's SOTA. This model integrates the last key component from Veritas II's architecture: a parallel 'Conv-Motif Detector' path designed to improve performance on challenging datasets like CRI-Off. This motif path runs in parallel to my 'DSConv + Transformer' main path. Their outputs are concatenated before being fed to task-specific heads. The hypothesis is that this dual-path approach will address the weaknesses of my previous model and achieve a SOTA-level score.
